items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Toolbar on Base UI Toolbar: one tab stop with arrow-key roving focus, buttons, toggles, links, separators, groups and an input.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose Toolbar with ToolbarButton, ToolbarToggle, ToolbarLink, ToolbarSeparator, ToolbarGroup (give it an aria-label) and at most one ToolbarInput, last. Pass render={<Menu.Trigger />} to ToolbarButton to wrap a trigger; use `disabled focusableWhenDisabled` to keep a disabled button in the arrow order.
